pr.title: feat(QPBT/Test): preserve Pauli soundness transfer estimates
pr.body:
### Motivation

- Address #529 by preserving the general range-projection and ancilla transfer estimates from original PR #536. These auxiliary results support the isometry comparison omitted in the source's final Pauli soundness argument.

### Description

- Preserve the general complete-POVM projection and conjugate-isometry transfer inequalities, unit-ancilla embedding and intertwining results, and five explicitly auxiliary blueprint entries.
- Keep the current global-pair and projective extraction constructions distinguished from the remaining concrete transfer, arbitrary-strategy reduction, source-domain comparison and final soundness obligations. The pauli_soundness statement and its existing sorry remain unchanged.
- Connect the final blueprint proof to the ancilla-intertwining and Alice/Bob transfer support results with explicit citations and dependency edges, addressing F1 of review 5245488540.
- Preserve the original PR #536 audit, failed attempts and cost history.

### Testing

- The bounded F1 fix changes only the blueprint chapter (seven insertions, three deletions). The chapter and all 652 tracked Lean files passed the repair hash manifest; no Lean file changed relative to the previously reviewed head.
- Blueprint web rendering, label resolution, LaTeX checks, 38 focused existing tests and normal commit hooks passed.
- Exact head e2396339890c393051b8166ba43d404b944e680d passed all nine local CI contexts in 355 seconds. The rooted blueprint axiom audit reports 1669 passing declarations, zero failures and three existing statement-level warnings; no proof-level marked declaration depends on sorryAx.
- Fresh bounded F1 recheck remains required before approval. The complete independent review and its unresolved finding remain recorded on the old head.

---
Addresses #529

# Bounded independent F1 recheck: PR 594 @ e2396339890c393051b8166ba43d404b944e680d

## Summary

Only F1 of the complete independent review 5245488540 was reopened. The
88d73454..e2396339 diff changes just `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex`
(7 insertions, 3 deletions); all Lean source and the source theorem statement are
unchanged. The prior full review, findings history, and original PR 536 cost
accounting (6020 + 1903 + 48 seconds) remain in force; this is not a replacement
full review.

## Findings

- [x] F1 (changes, S3/C5) `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:1137` — Resolved in e2396339: the `\proves{thm:pauli}` proof now has `\uses` edges to all three actual auxiliary statements, `thm:pauli-ancilla-intertwining-support`, `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-alice-support`, and `thm:pauli-isometry-transfer-bob-support`, and cites them respectively at the unit-ancilla embedding (line 1147), Alice's range-projection transfer (line 1201), and Bob's comparison (line 1219). Fix: completed by the chapter-only change.

The three labels resolve to the explicitly formalization-only statements at
chapter lines 1101-1123, 1044-1062 and 1072-1092. Their unit-ancilla,
intertwining and complete-POVM hypotheses match the cited uses. The paper's

`\leanok` or completeness claim for the source theorem; `pauli_soundness` still
has its pre-existing `sorry`. No unchecked findings in this bounded recheck.

Exact-head CI evidence reports nine successful contexts in 355 seconds and a
rooted audit of 1669 PASS, 0 FAIL, 3 existing statement-level WARN, with no
proof-level `sorryAx`. I independently checked the one-file diff, cited nodes,
paper passage, unchanged Lean paths and clean worktree; I did not rerun Lean,
build, CI, the axiom audit, or the earlier full mathematical review. Remaining
soundness obligations and the prior review's historical costs are not discharged
by this documentation repair.

VERDICT: APPROVED

pr.title: docs(QPBT): Preserve issue 513 historical scalar audit
pr.body:
## Motivation

`audits/2026-09-12_issue-513_composition-compatibility.md` on main cites the
second-attempt audit for issue #513 (PR #545) at
`audits/2026-09-12_issue-513_direct-error-absorption.md`, but that file is not
present on main, so the citation currently dangles. The preexisting
supersession report finds the scalar results and blueprint content of PR #545
already integrated on main; only this historical record is missing.

## Description

- Restore only the 172-line historical audit at its cited path, byte-identical
  to the body on the old PR #545 head `2f8f5cc4`, beneath valid YAML metadata
  and an explicit historical-status preface (194 lines total: 22 metadata and
  preface lines plus the unmodified original body).
- The preface qualifies the September 12 proof-hole and remaining-construction
  claims as historical, points at the successor record
  `audits/2026-09-14_issue-513_actual-error-absorption.md`, and keeps the
  composition record's caveat that dispatcher session `prover-513-20260912-02`
  failed without a completed final handoff.
- Original cost accounting and open obligations are preserved as historical
  data. This is no new proof and no claim about the current proof status.
- No Lean, blueprint, telemetry, or other audit file is changed; the branch is
  the single documentation commit merged up to current main.

## Testing

- Parsed the YAML front matter, checked the referenced repository paths, and
  compared the restored body against the source blob by SHA-256 and `cmp`
  (both identical).
- Checked the one-file diff and whitespace; committed through the installed
  repository hooks with a clean worktree; merged current main with hooks on.
- Documentation-only change: no Lean build result, blueprint render, or proof
  claim is asserted here beyond the repository CI run for this head.

Addresses #513
